test_status: REPLAY: models and synthetic data identical to v3; only decision thresholds for Na, Mg, Ca, Fe are re-selected on real laboratory development spectra. Preflight 64 and calib_2021 71 were both revealed earlier (v1 2026-10-13 and the adaptation final run). Development evidence, not an independent final.

base_protocol.inherits: sample selection, replicate handling, grid 350-800 nm step 0.1, observation windows [[383,468],[500,800]], classes, seeds, positive-only recall estimand

synthetic.variation_meaning: new plasma conditions, instrument draw and noise for the same composition
synthetic.bands_source: ChemCam VIO/VNIR resolution ranges from instrument documentation (Wiens et al. 2012, Space Sci. Rev. 170), fixed before the run
synthetic.neutral_variant: exact v1 linear neutral-template generator (240 base samples x 2) for attribution

line_features.template_conditions: T=10000 K, n_e=1e17 cm^-3, optically thin, mid-range band FWHM
line_features.window: peak +/-0.25 nm minus median of 0.6-1.5 nm side windows, same band; asinh(1000 x)

variants.purpose: reproduce v1 numbers with the same code path

thresholds: per-class F1 over distinct scores on synthetic validation (defaults 0.15 NNLS, 0.5 otherwise); with +ts: temperature fitted on half of validation base IDs, thresholds on the other half

metrics.primary_inherited: v1 positive-only recall (oxide > 0), equal physical-sample weight, cluster bootstrap
metrics.operational: positives >= 1 wt%, negatives (0, 0.1] wt% published oxide; recall, FPR, ROC-AUC on sample-mean scores; separate physical-sample bootstraps
metrics.calibration: Brier/ECE on synthetic test; Brier on real operational labels

reporting: All variants, models and seeds are reported. No variant, threshold or parameter is chosen on real results. A crashed run before metrics is not a result; any completed run is reported.
known_limitations: The real campaign is already revealed (replay).
Negative support is small: Na 14, Mg 7, Ca 2, Fe 3 materials.
Generator ranges come from literature, but the author has seen v1 results.
No real-spectrum fitting, alignment or threshold tuning.
Development spectra are LANL testbed 2013 measurements; preflight is the flight model before launch; calib_2021 test is the testbed in 2017-2019.
Some development standards share composition with preflight standards (same reference materials, different instrument and session).
Fe has only 8 development negatives, so its point FPR budget means 0/8.

real_thresholds.rule: spectralab_ml.evaluation.instrument_selection.select_operational_thresholds: maximum physical-sample recall subject to tuning point FPR <= 0.05; ties lower FPR then higher threshold. Unknown labels excluded. H and He keep synthetic thresholds.
real_thresholds.labels: adaptation protocol operational labels: positive >= 1 wt%, negative (0, 0.1] wt%, otherwise unknown
real_thresholds.models: trained only on synthetic data exactly as in v3; real spectra never enter fitting or calibration
real_thresholds.reported: for every variant/model/seed: preflight positive-only and operational metrics with real thresholds; calib_2021 test operational metrics with synthetic and real thresholds
